input_intervention: Raise conditioning observations of one variable by 0.5 SD of observed training values, preserving mask; recompute its interpolation by the same translation. Synthetic sensitivity probe, not a clinical intervention.
comparison: Paired same patients/noise; summarize all-draw preactivations for input effects to avoid median selection confounding. Scored median-selected activations saved for descriptive associations.
ablation: Exact last-step-only removal of individual/group head contributions across ALL 100 draws followed by a new median. Not full two-step ablation and not a candidate.
